basis: The base score uses the interested and uninterested keywords explicitly stored in the current SelfGrow settings. An optional user-approved profile may add validated weighted signals at runtime; no personal profile is bundled with the plugin.
purpose: Provide an advisory relevance score and disclose the configured keywords and approved profile signals matched by newly captured Raw material. The score must never auto-select, reject, delete, order, or distill content.
rules: Report only exact configured keyword strings in the matched-keyword arrays
Use semantic evidence from the source rather than requiring a literal text occurrence
Do not invent interests or profile signal IDs, infer identity, or use Vault material outside the current capture
When a personal profile is active, the model reports exact matched signal IDs and the plugin applies their declared weights to the base score
Explain the score in one concise sentence and keep a neutral score when no configured keyword matches

rubric.0-39: Weak fit or low-signal material with little reusable value
rubric.40-59: Some relevance but limited evidence, novelty, or practical depth
rubric.60-79: Useful and aligned material worth reviewing
rubric.80-100: Strongly aligned, evidence-rich, reusable material with clear practical value
